notes: Prefer camera_optical_axis_yx_px_by_z as 18 raw-sensor [y,x] positions measured with an aligned reference beam at the same 18 stage positions; this removes camera-stage runout without erasing real Bessel-beam walk. A single axis is accepted only when camera_optical_axis_single_value_valid_for_all_z is experimentally verified true. Do not guess values. The geometric SLM2 map is valid only if SLM2 is experimentally confirmed conjugate to the reconstructed input/axicon reference plane. If it is not conjugate, propagate/back-propagate the complex field through the measured relay instead of using a scale/rotation/parity remap.
